styles.hero: low-poly faceted 3D game character, hard flat-shaded polygon facets, lanky stylized proportions about 6.5 heads tall, thin limbs, large ears, big dark heavy-lidded eyes, deadpan expression, oversized shoes, plain neutral gray studio background, soft even lighting
styles.map: chunky chibi 3D game character, short stubby body about 3 heads tall, oversized head, hands and sneakers, blocky voxel-like low-poly with crisp pixel-art textures, plain muted teal background
styles.prop: low-poly faceted 3D game prop, hard flat-shaded polygon facets, painted flat textures, plain neutral gray studio background, soft even lighting

sheets.label: Hero turnaround
sheets.why: Front, 3/4, side and back of the same outfit. Used for modeling and image-to-3D. Once one is in the repo, it becomes this character's reference for the other sheets.
sheets.template: 3D character design reference sheet, the same character shown four times left to right: front view, three-quarter view, side profile, back view, identical outfit and hat in every view, full body standing straight, empty hands relaxed at sides, {LOOK}, {STYLE:hero}
sheets.params: --ar 16:9 --style raw --sref {HERO_SREF} {FACETED_SREF} --no text, labels, instrument, props, cropped feet

sheets.label: A-pose
sheets.why: Front and side in a rigging pose. Uses the turnaround as a strong reference so it's the same kid.
sheets.template: 3D character rigging sheet, front view and side view side by side, full body A-pose, arms straight and angled 45 degrees down and away from the body, palms facing down, legs shoulder-width apart, same character and outfit as the reference image, {IDENTITY}, {STYLE:hero}
sheets.params: --ar 3:2 --style raw --sref {HERO_SREF} {FACETED_SREF} {CHAR_REF:strong} --no text, instrument, props, extra limbs

sheets.label: Expressions
sheets.why: Six close-ups for battle reactions, as a 3×2 grid.
sheets.template: character expression sheet, six head-and-shoulders portraits of the same character in a 3 by 2 grid, expressions: neutral deadpan, focused concentration, smug grin, wide-eyed surprise, triumphant shout, defeated slump, same face, hat and hair in every panel, {IDENTITY}, {STYLE:hero}

sheets.label: Instrument
sheets.why: The drum alone in three views, modeled as a separate part. No character reference, so no person sneaks in.
sheets.template: game prop turnaround sheet of a single object: {INSTRUMENT}, shown three times: front view, side view, top-down view, isolated object, no people, {STYLE:prop}

sheets.label: Map version
sheets.why: Small, chunky version for the city map. Leads with the chibi proportions and uses only a light reference, so it keeps the outfit without copying the lanky body.
sheets.template: {STYLE:map}, turnaround sheet with front view, three-quarter view and back view, full body, holding {INSTRUMENT}, outfit: {IDENTITY}
sheets.params: --ar 16:9 --style raw --sref {MAP_SREF} {CHAR_REF:light} --no text, tall, lanky, thin limbs

characters.name: Bucket Busker
characters.note: Turnaround is inconsistent: the second view has a different patch-covered jacket and a pom-pom beanie, and there's no back view. Usable as a reference, but re-roll the turnaround before modeling.
characters.look: young street performer, light skin, black knit beanie with neon patches, oversized mustard bomber jacket covered in small sewn-on patches over a dark green hoodie, cuffed camo cargo pants, black and red high-top sneakers
characters.identity: young street performer, black patched beanie, mustard patch-covered bomber jacket, dark green hoodie, camo cargo pants, black and red high-tops
characters.instrument: a stack of upturned plastic paint buckets in different sizes with a hubcap used as a cymbal and drumsticks wrapped in grip tape
